changelog: A New Order can no longer be lost. If the mobile number, the customer name or an item is missing, the mistake is caught before saving — a red box at the top of the page lists exactly what is missing and takes you to that field.
The WhatsApp Yes/No popup no longer appears until the form is complete, so pressing Yes can never send an order the server will reject.

If a save does fail for any reason, the form comes back with everything still filled in — customer, job number, notes, advance, and every item line. Only the reference files have to be picked again, and the message says so.
Same protection on Edit Order: a failed save keeps the item lines you had typed.
